links.outcome: Junior reader sensitivity and specificity for abnormal screening with versus without AI assistance
links.effect: Junior-reader sensitivity rose from 69.7% to 91.7% with AI assistance; specificity went from 85.0% to 89.5%.
links.quote: In a 120-case multireader multicase reader study, Lingjian's assistance improved junior-reader sensitivity for abnormal screening from 69.7% to 91.7% while maintaining high specificity (85.0% to 89.5%).

links.outcome: Overall accuracy on national EQA compared with human expert group and general models
links.effect: Lingjian 93.0% overall accuracy vs human expert group 78.1% and Gemini-3 Pro 75.3%.
links.quote: On China's National Center for Clinical Laboratories External Quality Assessment (EQA, 2021-2025), it reached 93.0% overall accuracy, outperforming a human expert group (78.1%) and strong general models (e.g., Gemini-3 Pro, 75.3%).

unlisted_practices: Multistage domain adaptation of a vision-language model on laboratory images with grounding supervision
Release of model weights and evaluation resources for reproducibility

screen.reason: Evaluates the impact of vision-language AI assistance on clinician performance in a multireader multicase study.
